observations: 2014 study of methotrexate, lincRNA-p21, and NF-κB in rheumatoid arthritis patients and cell models.

entities.name: MTX-lincRNA-p21 NF-κB mechanism
observations: In RA-related primary cells and cell lines, methotrexate induced lincRNA-p21 and reduced TNFα-stimulated NF-κB activity; the reported effect depended on DNA-PKcs and lincRNA-p21.
